org/springframework/jms/annotation/JmsLi.summary: Annotation that marks a method to be the target of a JMS message listener on the specified destination.

containerFactory.summary: The bean name of the JmsListenerContainerFactory to use to create the message listener container.

destination.summary: The destination name for this listener, resolved through the container-wide DestinationResolver.

org/springframework/jms/annotation/JmsLi.summary: Container annotation that aggregates several @JmsListener annotations.

org/springframework/jms/annotation/Enabl.summary: Enable JMS listener annotated endpoints created under the cover by a JmsListenerContainerFactory.

org/springframework/jms/core/JmsTemplate.summary: Send the given object to the default destination, converting the object to a JMS message with a configured MessageConverter.
Send the given object to the named destination, converting the object to a JMS message.
Send the given object to the given Destination, converting the object to a JMS message.
Send a message to the default destination using a MessageCreator callback.
Send a message to the named destination using a MessageCreator callback.

jakarta/jms/MessageProducer#send()..summary: Sends a message using the MessageProducer's default delivery mode, priority, and time to live.

jakarta/jms/MessageListener#.summary: A MessageListener object is used to receive asynchronously delivered messages.

notes: Consumer destination: @JmsListener.destination (queue/topic name; resolution against JmsListenerContainerFactory's destinationResolver). MessageListener interface variant uses an externally-configured destination on the container — KS work. Producer destination: arity-1 send uses default destination; arity-2 first param is destination (string name OR Destination ref). Both jakarta.jms (JMS 3+) and javax.jms (JMS 2.x) MessageListener interfaces enumerated.
